task: society-lanes milestone 2: replicate the HERMES keep-right baseline and its collapse under assigned exits on BaSiGo 2013

errors.what: first BaSiGo download used the archive's plain-HTTP link and saved a 301 page

doc_friction.issue: next step 1 said the FZJ archive is refused by the proxy; it answered over HTTPS this session (the plain-http links on the wiki 301 to https, so scripts must use https)
limitations said positive head heights suggest z up; in BaSiGo the z column is a constant 176 cm, so the check carries no orientation information (now stated)

deviations.why: PROPOSAL said BaSiGo variants A and B 'differ only in the exit instruction'; the metadata show all A runs preceded all B runs, so the run-order confound could not be separated by design
deviations.did: registered a step-versus-drift test (B4) instead and reported the confound plainly
deviations.result: B4 held; the screen-information runs (0.995) further weaken a pure run-order reading

notes: Predictions B1-B6 committed before analysis (commit f34764852). All held. Unregistered: b_09/b_10 with 'screen information' reached 0.995 kept right; screen content undocumented (thesis host juser.fz-juelich.de served a JS bot challenge). Tried reading the overview video (range-requested one mp4 from the 538 MB zip) for screen content and a handedness check: monitors visible but unreadable; motion direction not resolvable from two frames. pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
